hook: Fifteen questions, no second chances. Can you score fifteen out of fifteen? Let us find out.

questions.question: Which is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.question_speech: Question one. Which is the largest ocean on Earth? A. Atlantic. B. Pacific. C. Indian. D. Arctic.

questions.question: Which is the smallest ocean?
questions.question_speech: Question two. Which is the smallest ocean? A. Arctic. B. Indian. C. Southern. D. Atlantic.

questions.question: What is the largest animal living in the ocean?
questions.question_speech: Question three. What is the largest animal living in the ocean? A. Whale shark. B. Orca. C. Blue whale. D. Giant squid.
questions.answer_speech: C is correct, the blue whale.

questions.question: About how much of Earth's surface is covered by ocean?
questions.question_speech: Question four. About how much of Earth's surface is covered by ocean? A. About 71 percent. B. About 50 percent. C. About 30 percent. D. About 90 percent.

questions.question: What is the deepest known part of the ocean?
questions.question_speech: Question five. What is the deepest known part of the ocean? A. Puerto Rico Trench. B. Mariana Trench. C. Java Trench. D. Tonga Trench.
questions.answer_speech: B is correct, the Mariana Trench.

questions.question: What kind of animal is a dolphin?
questions.question_speech: Question six. What kind of animal is a dolphin? A. Fish. B. Reptile. C. Mammal. D. Amphibian.

questions.question: How many arms does an octopus have?
questions.question_speech: Question seven. How many arms does an octopus have? A. Six. B. Ten. C. Twelve. D. Eight.

questions.question: What is a group of fish swimming together called?
questions.question_speech: Question eight. What is a group of fish swimming together called? A. A school. B. A pack. C. A herd. D. A flock.

questions.question: Which sea animal is called the unicorn of the sea?
questions.question_speech: Question nine. Which sea animal is called the unicorn of the sea? A. Narwhal. B. Dolphin. C. Walrus. D. Swordfish.

questions.question: What is the largest coral reef system in the world?
questions.question_speech: Question ten. What is the largest coral reef system in the world? A. Red Sea Reef. B. Belize Barrier Reef. C. Great Barrier Reef. D. Florida Reef.
questions.answer_speech: C is correct, the Great Barrier Reef.

questions.question: Which sea animal is known for its star shape?
questions.question_speech: Question eleven. Which sea animal is known for its star shape? A. Sea urchin. B. Starfish. C. Jellyfish. D. Sea cucumber.

questions.question: In which ocean is the Bermuda Triangle located?
questions.question_speech: Question twelve. In which ocean is the Bermuda Triangle located? A. Pacific. B. Indian. C. Atlantic. D. Arctic.

questions.question: Which animal can release ink to escape danger?
questions.question_speech: Question thirteen. Which animal can release ink to escape danger? A. Seahorse. B. Crab. C. Octopus. D. Turtle.

questions.question: Which is the largest fish in the world?
questions.question_speech: Question fourteen. Which is the largest fish in the world? A. Great white shark. B. Whale shark. C. Manta ray. D. Tuna.
questions.answer_speech: B is correct, the whale shark.

questions.question: In seahorses, which parent carries the babies?
questions.question_speech: Question fifteen. In seahorses, which parent carries the babies? A. The mother. B. The father. C. Both parents. D. Neither parent.
